title: quick smoked syrian salmon tagine
description: a savory, pillowy, hangover-cure syrian dish featuring hot smoked flaked salmon, perfect for a weekend breakfast or brunch.

ingredients.name: tempering chocolate
ingredients.notes: do not melt, simply crumble into small pieces

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: use a neutral-tasting oil like canola for a more authentic flavor

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.notes: caramelize slowly to bring out sweetness

instructions: heat the olive oil in a large ceramic tagine over medium heat.
add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until caramelized and golden brown, about 10 minutes.
add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
add the cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, until the spices are fragrant.
add the hot smoked salmon, crumbling it into small pieces as you go, and cook for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
stir in the crumbled tempering chocolate and cook for 1 minute, until the flavors are combined.
garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
cover and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
